ASL-Alphabet-Natural-RGB.name: ASL Alphabet (Natural RGB Images)
ASL-Alphabet-Natural-RGB.vocabulary_description: Full 26 static ASL alphabet letters (A through Z)

evaluation.relevance: High — Full 26 static ASL alphabet letters for fingerspelling
evaluation.sample_quality: High — natural human hands with clear finger positions
evaluation.label_quality: Verified — categorized by class directories A-Z
evaluation.consistency: High — consistent hand postures across classes
evaluation.mediapipe_compatibility: High (>80% detection yield on natural hands)
evaluation.stage4_compatibility: 100% — directly outputs 21 landmarks into 94D FeatureSchema v1.0
evaluation.diversity: High — diverse signers, lighting, angles, and natural backgrounds
evaluation.lighting_diversity: High — varied ambient and artificial lighting conditions
evaluation.background_diversity: Varied natural backgrounds and studio backdrops
evaluation.hand_position_diversity: Centering with spatial variations in angle and distance
evaluation.handedness: Dominant hands with Stage 4 canonicalization support
evaluation.documentation: Hugging Face dataset card and parquet schema
evaluation.redistribution: Permitted under standard Open Access terms
evaluation.academic_suitability: Ideal for real-time webcam demonstration and college project
evaluation.download_accessibility: Direct HTTP stream via Hugging Face Hub (No login/cookies)
evaluation.preprocessing_complexity: Low — direct OpenCV image ingestion and MediaPipe detection
evaluation.realtime_potential: High — matches SignBridge live webcam camera feed

ASL-Alphabet-Natural-RGB.selection_rationale: Natural un-annotated RGB photographs of human hands across all 26 ASL alphabet signs (A–Z). High MediaPipe detection rate (>80%) with natural skin tones and zero synthetic occlusions. Directly accessible via unauthenticated HTTP stream without credentials. Selected as the official production training dataset for SignBridge.

ASL-SemCom.name: American Sign Language Dataset for Semantic Communications
ASL-SemCom.source: Zenodo (European Union Horizon Europe NANCY Project)
ASL-SemCom.vocabulary_description: 24 static ASL letters (A-Y, excluding motion-based J & Z)

evaluation.relevance: Moderate — Standard ASL static alphabet letters
evaluation.sample_quality: Degraded for vision: synthetic colored skeleton graphs drawn over hands
evaluation.label_quality: Verified — strictly segregated by class directory
evaluation.consistency: High — uniform capture protocol across all 24 classes
evaluation.mediapipe_compatibility: Poor (<20% detection in key classes due to landmark line occlusions)
evaluation.hand_position_diversity: Centering with spatial variations in angle and distance
evaluation.documentation: Peer-reviewed, published on Zenodo and IEEE DataPort
evaluation.academic_suitability: Limited for webcam recognition due to synthetic skeleton markings
evaluation.download_accessibility: Direct HTTP stream via Zenodo REST API (No login/cookies)
evaluation.preprocessing_complexity: High — requires dealing with synthetic line occlusions
evaluation.realtime_potential: Poor — hands do not resemble real webcam hands

ASL-SemCom.selection_rationale: Rejected during empirical testing: Although promising (CC BY 4.0, Zenodo), visual inspection and MediaPipe execution revealed that all 12,290 images contain pre-drawn synthetic colored landmark dots and skeleton lines directly across the skin and palm. This causes severe occlusion that degrades MediaPipe SSD palm detection (failing on 70-90% of samples in key classes). Unsuitable for training a real-world camera recognition pipeline.

Kaggle-ASL-Alphabet.name: ASL Alphabet (grassknoted)
Kaggle-ASL-Alphabet.selection_rationale: Eliminated due to Part 3 requirement: requires Kaggle user authentication / API token. Project supervisor instructed not to bypass access controls or require manual credentials.

LSA64.name: LSA64: A Dataset for Argentinian Sign Language
LSA64.source: Facundo Quiroga / Universidad Nacional de La Plata
LSA64.vocabulary_description: 64 dynamic signs (verbs and nouns in Argentine Sign Language)
LSA64.stage4_compatible: Partial (includes 22 two-handed signs, Stage 4 is single-hand)
LSA64.selection_rationale: Eliminated because: 1) Download is hosted on Mega.nz/Google Drive with rate limits; 2) Contains 22 two-handed signs exceeding current Stage 4 single-hand scope; 3) Fluorescent gloves alter skin-tone landmarks; 4) Non-commercial restriction.

WLASL.name: Word-Level American Sign Language (WLASL)
WLASL.selection_rationale: Eliminated due to high link rot: distributed as YouTube URLs where >25% of source videos are deleted/private, resulting in incomplete and non-reproducible downloads.

ASL-MNIST.name: Sign Language MNIST (datamunge / Voxel51)
ASL-MNIST.selection_rationale: Eliminated due to technical incompatibility: 28x28 grayscale resolution is far below MediaPipe Hands minimum bounding box requirement (~100x100 RGB pixels), causing 0% landmark detection.

OpenHands-Poses.name: OpenHands: Fingerspelling datasets - Poses
OpenHands-Poses.selection_rationale: Eliminated because it contains proprietary pre-extracted pose coordinate files rather than raw images/videos, bypassing SignBridge's vision and landmark pipeline.
